layout.assets/<...>/<version>/<asset>_<version>: Real-time glTF binary of the asset only (Y-up, meters).
layout.assets/<...>/<version>/renders/: Rendered stills, turntable GIF/WebP previews and MP4 videos of that version.
layout.assets/<...>/<version>/asset.json: Metadata: parts, poly counts, render settings, tool versions.
layout.assets/<...>/<version>/mcp_transcript*.j: Every MCP tool call that built the version (one per render shard), with replies.
layout.blender/mcp/: Glue for driving Blender through MCP for Blender (headless host, server launcher, client).
layout.blender/recipes/<asset_name>/: Ordered steps (NN_name.py), each sent to Blender as one execute_blender_code call.
layout.tools/looks/: Post-render looks: vanity filter, 1970s CRT simulation, video assembly.
